title: Defense bases deliberately placed at natural portal sites like Area 51
place_text: Area 51 / Nevada Test Site / Skinwalker Ranch

tellings.quote: floors. Do you think that some of these defense bases are colllocated deliberately with, and this is going to sound really trippy, but like natural portals or something?

plain: Michels wonders aloud whether some US military sites, such as Area 51, a secret Air Force test site in Nevada, and places like Skinwalker Ranch, a ranch known for reports of strange events, were built on purpose at natural "portals" where unexplained things appear. He puts this to his guest, a researcher known as UAPGerb, as a question he admits sounds "really trippy", drawing on the book UFOs and Nukes by the researcher Robert Hastings and on claims by a man named Jake Barber. If so, the location of these bases since the 1950s would have been chosen for reasons the public was never told.
